notes: Samples NHPC-0 to NHPC-3 are N-doped hierarchical porous (activated) carbons made from carbonized PVP with KOH activation; C is 76.70-92.13 wt% (Table 1), so a majority-carbon sorbent. H2 uptake measured at 77 K and 87 K up to 1 bar (Quantachrome Autosorb-iQ, volumetric) and at 77 K and 298 K up to 130 bar (Sieverts-type BSD-PH2001); Section 3.3 states 'Excess H2 uptake was experimentally measured' at 77 K, 50 bar. Note the 50 bar, 77 K wt% values in Table 3 are total uptake from a Langmuir-Freundlich fit (Section 2.3, eq. 1), but 1 bar 77 K (3.02 wt% for NHPC-0), 87 K and 298 K values and the excess isotherms (Fig. 4d) are measured; this concerns extraction, not eligibility. Specific surface area (BET, N2 at 77 K) for all four samples is in Table 2 (3116.58, 2708.15, 2458.44, 1631.52 m2/g), same samples and 300 C outgassing as for H2. The first sentence of the abstract (43 words) is also English; the Introduction sentence is quoted to stay within 40 words. is_retracted is false in record.json; no retraction notice in the text. Text searched for statements that the H2 uptake values were published before; none found, and the paper's data are presented as new. Only the text layer and the page image of Table 3 / Figure 4 (main p. 6) were examined as images; SI (si1) holds Fig. S1 definition of excess vs total uptake, Table S1 literature comparison, Table S2 virial correlation coefficients.
